title: Correct round-trip time
description: Essential: The student must correctly identify the round-trip time from the emission interval and the ab=bc condition.

title: Distance formula application
description: Essential: The student must apply the formula s = (c * t) / 2 to calculate the distance to the obstacle.

title: Final numerical answer
description: Essential: The student must provide the correct final distance of 7.5 × 10³ m.

title: Interpretation of timing diagram
description: Important: The student must correctly relate the ab=bc condition on the indicator to the emission interval and pulse travel time.

title: Unit consistency
description: Important: The student must maintain consistent units (e.g., converting μs to s) in the calculation.

title: Explanation of reasoning
description: Optional: The student provides a clear step-by-step explanation of how the round-trip time is determined from the given conditions.

title: Forgetting factor of 1/2
description: Pitfall: The student calculates distance using s = c * t (one-way time) instead of s = (c * t) / 2 (round-trip time).

title: Misinterpreting ab=bc
description: Pitfall: The student misinterprets the ab=bc condition, leading to an incorrect round-trip time (e.g., using 100 μs or 1 μs).
